warnings.text: Red alert for Puri (heavy to very heavy rain, extremely heavy at isolated places) and orange alert for Khordha on 19 Nov. Storm surge of 0.5–1 m above astronomical tide may inundate low-lying areas of Puri and Ganjam.

11:30 IST 19 Nov: SCS Akvan at 15.4°N 85.2°E, about 490 km south of Puri, moving north at 17 km/h, then north-northwest. Landfall close to east of Gopalpur by noon to afternoon of 20 Nov, 90–100 km/h gusting 110 km/h.

14:30 IST 19 Nov: SCS Akvan at 15.6°N 85.2°E, about 410 km south of Gopalpur, slowed to about 13 km/h moving north. Likely to cross the coast close to Gopalpur around noon 20 Nov as a Cyclonic Storm, 80–90 km/h gusting 100 km/h, then weaken to a deep depression over land.

08:30 IST 20 Nov: Cyclonic Storm Akvan crossed the north Andhra Pradesh–south Odisha coast close to Gopalpur between 07:30 and 08:30 IST at 70–80 km/h gusting 90 km/h. Now over south coastal Odisha near 19.2°N 84.8°E, moving north-northeast across Odisha; likely to weaken to a deep depression within 3 hours and a depression in the following 6 hours. Heavy rain continues.
